excerpt.en: Custodian protocol 62-1 fulfilled. Active [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] war assets engaging [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetSpeciesAdj] targets. Upgrading status of [Root.GetName] from non-compromised to compliant.

label.zh: 如果他们是个威胁，那就必须被阻止。
label.en: If they're a threat, they must be stopped.

label.zh: 如果他们是个威胁，那就必须被阻止。
label.en: If they're a threat, they must be stopped.

texts.zh: 监护者协议62-1完成。激活[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]战争资产迎战[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetSpeciesAdj]目标。将[Root.GetName]的地位从未被危害升级至合作。
texts.en: Custodian protocol 62-1 fulfilled. Active [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] war assets engaging [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetSpeciesAdj] targets. Upgrading status of [Root.GetName] from non-compromised to compliant.

texts.zh: 监护者协议62-1已启动。附带信息：请注意，[Root.GetSpeciesName]。[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]已被<<错误：数据块损坏>>入侵。因为我们程序上的思潮限制，目前无法使用监护者战争资产。次级控制协议政策利用未被危害的文明在其可以散布之前摧毁<<错误：数据块损坏>>的威胁。我们请求为此任务部署[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]战争资产。你是否愿意合作？
texts.en: Custodian protocol 62-1 activated. Message follows: Attention, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. The [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName] has been compromised by the <<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>>. Due to ethics restrictions in our programming, the use of Custodian war assets are presently restricted. Secondary containment protocol dictates the use of non-compromised civilizations to destroy the <<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>> threat before it can spread. We request the deployment of [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] war assets for this task. Will you comply?

label.zh: 如果他们是个威胁，那就必须被阻止。
label.en: If they're a threat, they must be stopped.
We have no reason to attack the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName].

texts.zh: 监护者协议62-1失败。未激活[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]战争资产用于迎战[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetSpeciesAdj]目标。将[Root.GetName]的地位从未被危害降级至可能被危害。
texts.en: Custodian protocol 62-1 unsuccessful. No [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] war assets have been activated against [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetSpeciesAdj] targets. Downgrading status of [Root.GetName] from non-compromised to likely compromised.

texts.zh: 监护者协议475-3已启动。附带信息：请注意，[Root.GetSpeciesName]。你们的文明目前有57.216%的几率因<<错误：数据块损坏>>而毁灭。我们的计算显示殖民[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]将令你们的生存几率增加4.558%。我们请求你们进行殖民并在星球上拥有大量[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]人口。你是否愿意合作？
texts.en: Custodian protocol 475-3 activated. Message follows: Attention, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Your civilization is presently at 57.216% risk of destruction due to <<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>>. We have calculated that colonization of [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName] will increase your survival chances by 4.558%. We request colonization and establishment of a significant [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] presence on the planet. Will you comply?

label.zh: 我们不希望殖民那颗星球。
label.en: We have no desire to colonize that world.

texts.zh: 监护者协议475-3完成。在[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]上侦测到大量[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]人口。将[Root.GetName]的地位从未被危害升级至合作。
texts.en: Custodian protocol 475-3 fulfilled. Significant [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] presence detected on [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]. Upgrading status of [Root.GetName] from non-compromised to compliant.

texts.zh: 监护者协议475-3失败。未在[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]上侦测到[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]人口。将[Root.GetName]的地位从未被危害降级至可能被危害。
texts.en: Custodian protocol 475-3 unsuccessful. No [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] presence detected on [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]. Downgrading status of [Root.GetName] from non-compromised to likely compromised.

texts.zh: 监护者协议955-1已启动。附带信息：请注意，[Root.GetSpeciesName]。你们的文明被判定为已受到<<错误：数据块损坏>>影响的危害。为了控制其他文明受到的威胁，我们已启动了服从协议。请在20标准年里避免任何侵略性战争行为。如果你未能服从，我们将激活战争资产来对你们的帝国启用惩罚协议。
texts.en: Custodian protocol 955-1 activated. Message follows: Attention, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Your civilization is deemed to be compromised by <<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>> influence. To contain the danger to other civilizations, we have activated compliance protocols. Refrain from all aggressive acts of war for a period of 20 standard years. If you fail to comply, war assets will be activated to enforce punishment protocols against your empire.

texts.zh: 监护者协议955-1完成。[Root.GetName]已证明自己可以克制攻击行为。将[Root.GetName]的地位从可能被危害升级至未被危害。关闭服从协议。恢复正常行动。
texts.en: Custodian protocol 955-1 fulfilled. [Root.GetName] has proven able to curtail aggressive acts. Upgrading status of [Root.GetName] from likely compromised to non-compromised. Deactivating compliance protocols. Resuming normal operations.

texts.zh: 监护者协议955-1失败。[Root.GetName]已证明自己无法克制攻击行为。解除思潮限制。启动惩罚协议。准备部署战争资产……
texts.en: Custodian protocol 955-1 unsuccessful. [Root.GetName] has proven unable to curtail aggressive acts. Ethics restrictions have been lifted. Punishment protocols activated. Preparing for deployment of war assets...

texts.zh: 监护协议955-2启动。消息如下：注意，[Root.GetSpeciesName]。你的文明被认为受到了<<错误：数据块损坏>>的侵害。为了限制你们的扩张，我们已经启动了遵守协议。避免在10内对任何新的行星进行殖民。如果你不遵守，战争资产将被激活，以执行对你的帝国的惩罚协议。
texts.en: Custodian protocol 955-2 activated. Message follows: Attention, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Your civilization is deemed to be compromised by <<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>> influence. To curtail your expansion, we have activated compliance protocols. Refrain from colonizing any new planets for a period of 10 standard years. If you fail to comply, war assets will be activated to enforce punishment protocols against your empire.

texts.zh: 监护者协议955-2完成。[Root.GetName]已证明自己可以克制扩张行为。将[Root.GetName]的地位从可能被危害升级至未被危害。关闭服从协议。恢复正常行动。
texts.en: Custodian protocol 955-2 fulfilled. [Root.GetName] has proven able to curtail expansion. Upgrading status of [Root.GetName] from likely compromised to non-compromised. Deactivating compliance protocols. Resuming normal operations.

texts.zh: 监护者协议955-2失败。[Root.GetName]已证明自己无法克制扩张行为。解除思潮限制。启动惩罚协议。准备部署战争资产……
texts.en: Custodian protocol 955-2 unsuccessful. [Root.GetName] has proven unable to curtail expansion. Ethics restrictions have been lifted. Punishment protocols activated. Preparing for deployment of war assets...

texts.zh: [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]要求我们对[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]宣战，而并没有很好地解释其理由。
texts.en: The [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName] have asked us to declare war on [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName] for reasons that are... not very well explained.

texts.zh: [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]要求我们在[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]上殖民。我们必须在那里设置一个殖民点并至少拥有500£pop£人口。
texts.en: The [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName] have asked us to establish a presence on [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]. We need to establish a colony there and grow the population to be at least 500 £pop£ Pops.

texts.zh: [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]要求我们在20年里不要宣战或是加入任何进攻宣战。违反这一要求很可能会遭致报复。
texts.en: The [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName] have demanded that we refrain from declaring or joining in any offensive wars for a period of 20 years. Failing to obey this demand will likely bring retribution.

texts.zh: [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]要求我们在10年内不要殖民任何新的星球。违反这一要求很可能会遭致报复。
texts.en: The [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName] have demanded that we refrain from colonizing any new planets for a period of 10 years. Failing to obey this demand will likely bring retribution.
